animauxNous.modesDesc: The 12 questions are the same in both cases. Together, you each answer separately and the quiz looks for the animal couple you're most like.
animauxNous.modeDuoDesc: You each answer the 12 questions on the same phone, without seeing the other's answers.
animauxNous.modeDuoMeta: Your animal couple and your differences
animauxNous.modeSolo: On my own, for our couple
animauxNous.modeSoloDesc: You answer with your couple in mind.
animauxNous.setupDescDuo: Enter your first names. The first person answers the 12 questions and then passes the phone. At the end, you'll see the animal couple you're most like and the questions where you gave different answers.
animauxNous.setupDescSolo: The quiz asks 12 questions about your life together, for example about your Sundays or your arguments. Answer with your couple in mind and you'll see which animals you're most like.
animauxNous.relaisDebut: Answer the 12 questions, then pass the phone.
animauxNous.relaisSuite: {{nom}} is done. Your turn, no peeking at their answers!
animauxNous.conseilTitre: The advice that goes with it
animauxNous.chacunMeme: On your own, you would each have got the same animals. You see your couple the same way!
animauxNous.chacunGagne: Your animal couple is the one {{nom}} got. It's the one with the most points when your answers are added up.
animauxNous.chacunCompromis: Your animal couple isn't the one either of you got alone. It's the one with the most points when your answers are added up.
animauxNous.memesReponsesUne: Just one identical answer out of {{total}}.
animauxNous.accordHaut: You see your couple in more or less the same way.
animauxNous.accordMoyen: You agree on the main things but you don't see everything the same way.
animauxNous.accordBas: You don't see your couple the same way at all. Compare your answers, it's worth talking about!
animauxNous.invitationDuo: And which animals does your partner see in your couple? Take the quiz again together to compare your answers.
animauxNous.noteFin: This quiz is a game. It plays with what we know about these animals but it says nothing serious about your relationship. The photos were created for this page.
animauxNous.p_loutres_d: You're a very affectionate couple. You love being close to each other, on the sofa and in the street. Sea otters do the same. They sometimes hold paws when they sleep on the water, so they don't drift apart!
animauxNous.p_loutres_a: Still keep some time on your own. You'll have even more to tell each other in the evening.
animauxNous.p_manchots_d: You're a couple with your own habits and lots of little attentions. In some penguin species, the male brings pebbles to the female to build their nest. You do much the same with your little presents for no reason. You also have your own places and you love going back to them.
animauxNous.p_manchots_a: Your habits make you feel safe and that's a good thing. Just try a new place from time to time, to make one more memory.
animauxNous.p_loups_d: You're a close-knit couple who put your people first. A wolf pack is a family above all, with a breeding pair and their young. For you too, family and close friends matter a lot. When one of you has a problem, the other stands up for them straight away.
animauxNous.p_loups_a: Think about your couple too. Keep one evening a week with nobody else, even when the house is often full.
animauxNous.p_cygnes_d: You're a very romantic couple. Two swans often stay together for years. When they face each other, their necks form a heart. You love declarations of love and dates that matter. You probably have a song that's just yours!
animauxNous.p_cygnes_a: Romance also shows in small everyday gestures. A kind word on a Tuesday evening counts as much as a fancy dinner.
animauxNous.p_dauphins_d: You're a playful couple who love having people around. Dolphins live in groups and spend a lot of time playing. At your place, there are often guests and a lot of laughter. Your friends invite you together because you bring the fun.
animauxNous.p_dauphins_a: Keep some time for your couple. A quiet evening with no phones will do you as much good as a big dinner with friends.
animauxNous.p_renards_d: You're a close couple who love to tease. In fables, the fox is always the clever one. At home, you tease each other from morning to night. You have your own jokes and nobody else gets them. One look is enough to make you burst out laughing.
animauxNous.p_renards_a: Humour helps with a lot of things. Still remember to say the serious things without a joke from time to time.
animauxNous.p_chats_d: You're an independent couple. A cat likes its peace and comes for a cuddle when it feels like it. You do the same. You each have your own hobbies and friends, then you meet up again in the evening. You don't need to be glued together to be happy.
animauxNous.p_chats_a: Your freedom is a strength. Still plan some time together every week so you don't end up living like flatmates.
animauxNous.p_castors_d: You're a couple who build things. Beavers live in pairs and build their dam and their lodge together. You always have a project on the go, for example some DIY or a move. You're happy when you're moving forward side by side.
animauxNous.p_castors_a: One finished project often leads to another. Take the time to enjoy what you've already built before you start the next one.
animauxNous.p_chouettes_d: You're a couple of night owls. Owls are mostly active at night. You're at your best in the evening too. You can talk for hours and put the world to rights until 2 in the morning. Your best conversations start when everyone else is asleep.
animauxNous.p_chouettes_a: Your long talks are precious. Just remember to get some sleep, especially when you have an early start!
animauxNous.p_chienchat_d: You're very different and you bicker a lot. People say “fight like cat and dog” about two people who argue all the time. With you, these little rows don't last and they often end in a fit of laughter. You make a good team because each of you brings what the other doesn't have.
animauxNous.p_chienchat_a: Your differences are a good thing as long as you can laugh about them. If one topic keeps coming back, sit down and talk it through calmly.
